name: Daniel Liu
quote: if it compiles, ship it. if it doesn't, ship it louder.
description: Currently building interactive web experiences with React and Three.js. Interested in creative coding, generative art, and the intersection of design and engineering. Previously worked on frontend tooling at a stealth startup and freelanced for small businesses around Windsor.

name: Timothy Zheng
quote: buy low, sell high. how hard can it be?
description: Graduated CFM in 2026 and went straight into power trading. Spent co-op terms at Ontario energy firms modeling electricity futures. Now trades real-time power markets and occasionally mentors current CFM students on breaking into commodities.

name: Aadya Khanna
description: Drawn to the intersection of technology, creativity, and financial markets

name: Marcus Chen
quote: I mass-apply to Jane Street every 4 months like clockwork.
description: Competitive programmer turned quant. Spent a co-op at Citadel Securities working on low-latency execution systems in C++. Interested in statistical arbitrage, market microstructure, and building trading infrastructure that doesn't fall over at market open.

name: Priya Sharma
quote: my GPU bill is more than my tuition.
description: Research-oriented ML engineer focused on NLP and large language models. Worked in the UW NLP Lab on document understanding and retrieval-augmented generation. Kaggle Competitions Master. Wants to bridge the gap between ML research and production systems in fintech.

name: Jordan Park
quote: I mass-rewrite everything in Rust and regret nothing.
description: Systems programmer who thrives close to the metal. Did a co-op at AMD working on GPU driver internals. Contributes to Rust open-source projects and runs a homelab with custom Linux kernels. Exploring how low-latency systems design applies to HFT infrastructure.

name: Sophie Wang
quote: correlation is not causation but it's close enough for a demo.
description: Data scientist with a love for storytelling through visualization. Co-op at RBC's capital markets team building risk dashboards and anomaly detection pipelines. Enjoys photography and believes good data viz is just photography for numbers.

name: Ethan Zhao
quote: moved a button 2px to the left. it changed everything.
description: Product designer who codes. Interned at Figma working on component library tooling. Believes design systems are the best investment a team can make. Currently exploring how AI can augment the design process without replacing the human touch.

name: Nina Patel
quote: it works on my machine. so I containerized my machine.
description: Infrastructure engineer who automates everything. Co-op at AWS on the EKS team, building internal deployment pipelines. Runs a 6-node homelab and has strong opinions about GitOps. Interested in platform engineering and making developer experience less painful.
